rounds.recommendations: When designing mutation tests for kernels with multiple dimension-handling branches, ensure the test suite covers all supported tensor dimensionalities (1D, 2D, 3D, etc.) to properly exercise all code paths. A single fixed shape may leave entire branches untested.
